bio: Since January 2025, Gasthof zum Bad has had this interesting alternative to its fine dining restaurant for evening meals – and diners have been lapping up the pleasingly unpretentious concept. Chef-owner Hans Häge serves up delicious regional classics that draw on his family's traditional recipes. Don't miss out on enticing options on the menu such as rump steak of Bavarian beef or lentils with spaetzle & Vienna sausage, or Badwirt's Maultaschensuppe....
